title: nbisweden/grave pipeline parameters
description: A workflow for mapping and variant calling aDNA against pangenome graphs

steps.description: The workflow steps to execute (comma-separated string)

reference.description: Path to reference file, see also --reference_type

reference_type.description: The type of reference provided. Graphs: '.gbz' format, linear references: '.fasta' format

multi_reference_graphs.title: Multi-reference graphs
multi_reference_graphs.description: Set when the graph contains multiple reference samples

multiple_references.description: Run grave assuming the graph contains multiple reference samples, see also --paths_dir

project.description: SLURM account (project code to log compute hours in)

gpu_giraffe.description: Use a GPU accelerated version of giraffe

keepRawGam.description: Publish raw GAM files in addition to standard filtered outputs

rawMapStats.description: Publish stats on the raw GAM (includes unmapped)

keepRawVcf.description: Publish raw VCF files in addition to standard filtered & normalised output

discardUnmerged.description: When merging aDNA reads, discard unmerged. Otherwise, unmerged are combined with merged and treated as single-end reads

fastpDedup.description: Remove duplicate reads detected by exact hash match

dupCalcAccuracy.description: Accuracy of duplication rate estimation: if setting --fastpDedup, use 3+, else use 1

readDiscardLength.description: Discard fragments less than INT bases

minFastpOverlapLength.description: Minimum required overlap for FASTP merging of paired-end reads

aDNAkmerLength.description: aDNA samples: K-mer length for minimizer computation (+ read K-mer profiling in unfiltered_graph mode)

aDNAwindowLength.description: aDNA samples: Window length for minimizer computation

modernKmerLength.description: Modern samples: K-mer length for minimizer computation (+ read K-mer profiling in unfiltered_graph mode)

modernWindowLength.description: Modern samples: Window length for minimizer computation

noNestedDistance.description: Developers: produce limited version of the distance index (lower memory imprint)

aDNA_gap_open_penalty.description: Giraffe alignment (aDNA reads): gap open penalty

aDNA_gap_extend_penalty.description: Giraffe alignment (aDNA reads): gap extend penalty

kffKmerMinimum.description: Haplotype subsampling: minimum frequency of read K-mer for consideration

gamDiscardUnmapped.description: GAM: Discard unmapped reads when filtering

minimumMapQFilter.description: GAM: MAPQ threshold applied when filtering, requires --gamFilterMapQ

alignIdentityFilter.description: GAM: Apply alignment fraction identity filtering

minimumScorePrimaryAlign.description: GAM: Fraction identity required to keep primary alignment during filtering, requires --alignIdentityFilter

gamDefrayEnds.description: GAM: Clip the ends of ambiguously aligned reads

defrayEndsLength.description: GAM: maximum bases to clip from read ends, requires --gamDefrayEnds

bwaFilterMapQ.description: BAM (linear mode only): Apply MAPQ filtering

bwaMinimumMapQFilter.description: BAM (linear mode only): MAPQ threshold applied when filtering, requires --bwaFilterMapQ

dedupConsiderBothEnds.description: aDNA: consider 5' and 3' alignment positions when identifying duplicate reads. If false, consider the 5' position

removeDuplicates.description: Remove duplicate reads. If false, duplicates are marked and the tagging policy is applied

duplicateTaggingPolicy.description: Policy for tagging duplicates in the DT SAM tag

minimumAlleleSupport.description: General: Minimum allele support for a call

maxNestLevel.description: Genotyping: Maximum variant nest level. Discards VCF variants over this 'nest' level from genotyping outputs, unless found in a popped feature, i.e., reference allele was over --maxRefLength. Does not affect raw VCF output

maxRefLength.description: Genotyping: Maximum reference allele size. Pops/discards VCF variants if the reference allele is over this value, retaining variants nested within the popped variant (even if they are nested above --maxNestLevel). Does not affect raw VCF output

minimumSiteSupport.description: Genotyping: Minimum site support for a call

baselineErrorSmallVariants.description: Genotyping: Baseline error rates for Poisson model for small variants

baselineErrorLargeVariants.description: Genotyping: Baseline error rates for Poisson model for large variants

freebayes_mode.description: FreeBayes: run in normal mode (single-threaded), or parallel mode (experimental)

maxComplexGap.description: FreeBayes: Maximum distance between polymorphisms on the same read

minFraction.description: FreeBayes: Require at least this fraction of observations supporting an alternate allele within a single individual in the in order to evaluate the position

deepVariantModelType.description: Deepvariant: The model to use, based on the read data type

version.description: Print the workflow version and exit

tracing.description: Output workflow execution reports (resource/timeline reports and DAG image)
